 Advertising How To Watch Titans vs Bengals Week 8: TV, Streaming and Radio Information
 Oct 26, 2026 at 08:00 PM 
 Copied! 
 The Cincinnati Bengals return to Paycor Stadium to play the Tennessee Titans in Week 8 on Sunday, November 2, at 1 p.m. ET. The game will air on CBS and can be streamed on Paramount+ or NFL+ locally and on NFL Sunday Ticket nationally.
 Bengals at Ravens Game Information
 Date: Sunday, November 2, 2026
 Kickoff: 1 p.m. ET
 TV: CBS
 Streaming: Paramount+ , NFL+ , NFL Sunday Ticket , NFL Game Pass International 
 Radio : 700 WLW, 1530 WCKY and 102.7 WEBN
 Live Coverage : Bengals.com and the Bengals App
 What channel is Titans vs Bengals on?
 Titans vs Bengals will air on CBS. Tom McCarthy will call play-by-play alongside Robert Turbin as analyst and Tiffany Blackmon as sideline reporter.
 Click here for more ways to watch, including a full season coverage schedule based on your location .
 How to stream Titans vs Bengals
 Fans in the local television markets can stream the game through Paramount+ or NFL+ . If you are not in market, you can stream the game through NFL Sunday Ticket . If you are international, you can watch the game through DAZN (excludes China) .
 How to listen to Titans vs Bengals
 The Bengals Radio Network broadcast can be heard in Cincinnati on 700 WLW, 1530 WCKY and 102.7 WEBN. Dan Hoard will call play-by-play alongside analysts Dave Lapham and Tony Pike. You can also listen to the game on SiriusXM Ch. 192.
 Titans vs Bengals Gameday Coverage
 Follow Titans vs Bengals live: Get all your gameday coverage at  Bengals-Titans Game Center or the Bengals Mobile App , including up-to-date photo galleries, highlights and stats.
 Follow the Bengals on social media for live updates, and subscribe to Bengals emails to get all your pregame and postgame content in one place.
 Where to watch Titans vs Bengals with other Bengal fans 
 Looking for a place to watch Bengals games and connect with other Bengals fans in your town? We've made it easy. Tap to view the official Bengals Bars and see where you can watch Bengals games surrounded by other members of Who Dey Nation. 
 Check out the Bengals 2026 Schedule .
